config.world: Tangent perturbations carried by the linearised flow of Lorenz-63 (sigma 10, rho 28, beta 8/3), of Lorenz-63 extended by one decoupled linear direction u' = mu u that the observer does not read (World K, mu = 2 and the control mu = 0.5), and of Lorenz-96 (N = 40, F = 8); observers as constant diagonal read operators; starts on the attractor from one spun-up trajectory at a fixed spacing; one RK4 integration of state and tangent vectors per start.
